messages:
anya: Hey team — I'm putting together a compressed 'Quick Kit' one-sheet for enterprise leads that combines security, SLA, and deployment guidance. Goal: one PDF SEs/sales can send after discovery. Draft here: https://notion.so/rdw-enterprise-quickkit (WIP). Need quick feedback on structure + inbound routing rules. Deadline: EOD Tue. :memo:

mike: Nice. For routing, please include explicit tags so inbound automation can route: enterprise_security, private_deploy, sla_negotiation. Sales needs clear MQL -> AE triggers (e.g., trial + compliance checkbox). :eyes:

sara: Agree with structure. Suggest 3 panels: 1) Who this is for (personas + key outcomes), 2) Deployment matrix (Hosted / Dedicated / Private) w/ tradeoffs, 3) Security & SLA summary + next steps. Add two benchmark callouts (latency and cost delta) but flag that numbers are estimates until product confirms. Keep hero language benefit-first, not raw metrics.

ben: Security thumbs-up. Must call out: SOC2 Type II, KMS/HSM integrations, data residency options, audit logging & egress controls, and optional on-prem air-gapped. Also state incident notification timings and support levels tied to SLA. Avoid any language that implies we will accept unbounded data retention. :lock:

leo: I can get verified p99 latency and cost-per-1k-token numbers by Monday. Recommendation: where possible use relative language in marketing ("up to 3x faster" / "lower unit cost") and put exact numbers in appendix or internal-only notes. Also propose a tiny diagram for routing (Hosted -> Dedicated -> Private) showing when customers should pick each.

deploy-bot: benchmarks/enterprise-latency-2026.csv uploaded to /shared/benchmarks — includes hosted vs dedicated p50/p95/p99 and cost-per-1k token approximations.

mike: For sales enablement, add a short playbook snippet: 1) If prospect cites regulatory + encryption + isolated hardware -> route to Enterprise AE and SE for Private. 2) If prospect asks about predictable throughput + committed spend -> Dedicated sales path. 3) All others -> Hosted trial + nurture. Also include checklist fields for the PDP form (region, compliance, expected qps, retention).

sara: For the webinar tie-in (next month): we can use the one-pager as the follow-up asset. Idea: "Choosing the right deployment for latency, cost, and compliance" — include a short benchmark panel from the one-pager. Marketing will craft a 45s hero animation showing routing decisions.

anya: Action items: - sara: final layout & copy draft by Mon EOD (internal) - leo: verified numbers and appendix by Mon EOD - ben: one security bullet paragraph and approved phrasing by Tue AM - mike: routing tags + sales playbook bullets for the PDP by Tue AM - I'll assemble final PDF + short email template for AE by Tue EOD. Please add any blockers here. :rocket:

mike: No blockers. Will sync with AE leads Thu morning to confirm routing tags.

sara: Will avoid hero raw numbers unless leo confirms.

anya: Thanks — I'll iterate on the Notion doc and ping again when the draft is ready for review. If anyone wants to drop quick copy snippets, paste them into the doc under "marketing copy". :thumbsup:
